Greek Yogurt Marinated Chicken
Makes 6 servings

What you'll need
* 2 ½ pounds chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
* 1 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
* 2 Tbsp lemon juice
* 1 Tbsp dried oregano
* 4 cloves garlic, grated
* 1 tsp kosher salt
* 1 1/2 cups dry orzo

Directions
1) Combine the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, oregano, garlic and salt in a bowl.
2) Add the chicken thighs and marinate at least 2 hours.
3) Grill the chicken thighs over medium-high heat 5-6 minutes per side.
4) Cook the orzo according to the package and serve with the chicken.
